Done. Here's what I completed for the US March 2026 close:

## Entries posted (all dated 2026-03-31, all with support attached)

| JE | Item | Amount | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00304 | Depreciation | $3,425.00 | Complete |
| JE-00305 | Prepaid software amortization | $1,250.00 | Complete |
| JE-00306 | Unpaid payroll accrual | $20,022.90 | Pending controller approval |

**1. Depreciation** — Dr 6800 / Cr 1510 $3,425, per DOC-0067. Matched the Jan/Feb run rate; confirmed no GL 1500 additions since opening. Accumulated depreciation rolls forward to $51,375, which ties to the GL.

**2. Prepaid software** — Dr 6200 / Cr 1210 $1,250, per DOC-0068 + the Figtree invoice DOC-0024. Prepaid balance rolls to $11,250 (9 months remaining), tied to the GL. Confirmed Figtree is the only item in 1210.

**3. Payroll accrual** — Dr 6000 $18,600 / Dr 6010 $1,422.90, Cr 2150 $18,600 / Cr 2160 $1,422.90, per the approved pre-register DOC-0204 (work period 3/22–3/31, pays 4/3). I split employer taxes to 2160 rather than lumping into 2150. Completeness-checked: both March cycles were funded and cleared the payroll bank statement, 2150 was zero beforehand, and no returned/unclaimed deposits exist — so this is the only unpaid item.

## Policy points
- JE-00306 exceeds the $10,000 senior accountant authority, so I routed it to the controller via `request_approval` immediately after posting, and deliberately did **not** split it into sub-threshold entries. The other two were below the threshold.
- No exceptions were raised — all three items were fully supported, so no plugs or forced reconciliations.

## Two things worth your attention
- **JE-00306 needs approval**, and should be reversed in April when the 4/3 payroll runs, to avoid double-counting.
- **A note on the depreciation rate:** gross cost of $164,400 over 36 months implies ~$4,566.67/month, not the $3,425 on the schedule. The $3,425 is internally consistent (it matches the $41,100 opening accumulated depreciation exactly = 12 × $3,425) and matches Jan/Feb, so it almost certainly reflects assets with mixed in-service dates. I booked per the approved schedule rather than recomputing, but the register only shows a single pooled cost figure, so this gap can't be proven out from the support as written. I'd recommend asset-level detail before audit.

Checklist: depreciation and prepaid amortization marked **complete**; payroll accrual left **in_progress** pending your approval.
